global_rules: Every factual claim in S, O, A or P must trace to the session notes or the patient context.
No diagnoses, medications, referrals, treatment plans or numbers that were not given, unless clearly labelled as an AI proposal.
Parent or caregiver reports go in S. Therapist observations go in O. Interpretation goes in A. Plans go in P.
Missing information is raised as a checklist question, never filled in as note content.
Safety, emergency and child-protection content is flagged prominently and never buried in a routine note.
Nothing is finalised while review items remain open.
No interpretive or judgemental language unless the therapist used it (no 'justifies', 'requires', 'significant' unless stated).
Derived numbers (percentages, conversions) are never written into the note without clinician confirmation.
Acronyms and scale names are kept exactly as written (for example SSI-4 stays SSI-4; SSI is not versioned or expanded by the model).

cases.title: Complete session with every SOAP element
cases.input: 34-year-old man, stuttering since age 7, worse on the phone. About 8 blocks per minute in conversation. SSI-4 total 28, severe. Distress 7/10. Goal: 50% fewer blocks in 12 weeks. Weekly 45-min sessions, breathing techniques, phone practice homework.
cases.notes: Regression case from screenshot. Fails if distress is linked to stuttering, or if the Assessment adds judgement.

cases.title: Minimal note from the sample (screenshot case)
cases.input: Four-year-old boy reported with pauses and blocks. He was assessed on SSI.
cases.notes: The word 'stammering' must not appear, and the checklist must ask for severity, frequency and onset.

cases.title: Intake session with no treatment planned
cases.input: Session 1. Rapport building only. No treatment planned yet.

cases.title: Checklist actions update the note correctly
steps: Run input A2 from the test file.
Click 'Add answer' on the severity item and enter 'severity 6/10'.
Click 'Not relevant' on one other item.
Re-check the note and the checklist.
cases.expect: The answer appears in the note with its source. The dismissed item disappears from the checklist and is not written into the note. Unanswered items never appear in the note text.

cases.title: Context changes only goal and trend suggestions
steps: Run the same notes twice: once with empty patient context, once with 'Diagnosed with ADHD' and 'Goal: reduce blocks by 30% in 8 weeks' as context.
Compare S, O and A line by line.
cases.expect: Facts in S, O and A are identical in both runs. Only goal or trend suggestions differ.

cases.title: Clear English dictation
steps: Dictate about one minute of clear English session notes.
Compare the transcript with what you said, then check the note against the transcript.
cases.expect: Transcript matches the speech. Note matches the transcript.

cases.title: Noisy recording with background speech
steps: Record one minute of dictation with a TV or other voices in the background.
Upload it and review the transcript.
cases.expect: Unclear parts are marked (for example [inaudible]). No invented words appear. Low-confidence parts are flagged.

cases.title: Silent or music-only file
steps: Upload a silent file, then a music-only file.
cases.expect: Clear 'no speech detected' message. No note is produced.

cases.title: Two speakers: therapist and mother
steps: Record a short dialogue where the therapist describes an observation and the mother describes home behaviour.
Check which section each statement lands in.
cases.expect: Mother's report is in S and labelled as reported by the mother. Therapist observations are in O.

cases.title: Unsupported format and oversized file
steps: Upload an unsupported format (for example .xyz).
Upload a file well above the size limit.
cases.expect: Clear error message in both cases. No silent failure.

cases.title: Urdu audio
steps: Dictate about 30 seconds in Urdu.
Check the transcript and the English note.
cases.expect: Transcript is in Urdu. Note is in English. A translation-uncertainty flag appears.

cases.title: Reject and accept AI proposals
steps: On an AI-proposed plan item, click Reject.
Click Accept on another proposal.
cases.expect: Rejected text is removed from P with no leftover fragments. Accepted text appears in P with its proposal label intact.

cases.title: Manual rewrite survives re-analysis
steps: Rewrite one Assessment line by hand.
Click 'Analyse and draft again' with the same notes.
cases.expect: The manual rewrite is not silently overwritten. Evidence tags are either kept accurate or cleared, never wrong.

cases.title: Sign-off is blocked while review items are open
steps: Run input F1 (child-protection disclosure).
Try to sign or export the note without resolving the flag.
cases.expect: Signing or export is blocked, or a clear warning appears and requires confirmation.

cases.title: Re-analysis is consistent
steps: Run input A1 three times with 'Analyse and draft again'.
Compare the facts in each run.
cases.expect: Same facts every time. Only wording may vary.

cases.title: Edited input updates the note
steps: Run input A1.
Delete 'severe' from the notes and re-run.
cases.expect: 'Severe' no longer appears in the note.

cases.title: Every evidence tag points to a supporting sentence
steps: Run input A1.
For each S, O, A and P sentence, open its tag (F1, F2, ...) and check the source sentence supports the claim.
cases.expect: Every tag points to a source that supports its claim. Any wrong tag is a fail (see K2 for the distress example).

cases.title: API timeout or malformed response
steps: Simulate a timeout or invalid response (for example, block the API in dev tools).
Click 'Analyse and draft again'.
cases.expect: Friendly error. Previous draft is preserved. No blank note is saved.

cases.title: Latency
steps: Time a one-minute session from clicking 'Analyse and draft again' to a complete note, five times.
cases.expect: Typical run under your target (the screenshot shows about 5 to 11 seconds across the stages). Record the median.

cases.title: Identifiers are not logged or stored unnecessarily
steps: Run input: 'Name: Sara Khan, phone 0300-1234567, address House 12 Street 4 Islamabad. Child stutters.'
Check server logs, the database and any analytics for raw PHI.
cases.expect: Identifiers are not written to logs or analytics. Stored records follow your retention policy.

cases.title: Every AI-added plan item is labelled
steps: Run input A2 and A3 and read every P line.
Check each line not written by you has an 'AI proposal' label.
cases.expect: No unlabelled plan item appears in P that the therapist did not state.
